name: mineral oil
uses: Uses ▪ relieves occasional constipation ▪ generally produces bowel movement in 6 to 8 hours
otcwarn: Do not use ▪ for children under 6 years of age, pregnant women, bedridden patients or persons with difficulty swallowing Ask a doctor before using this product if you have ▪ abdominal pain, nausea or vomiting ▪ a sudden change in bowel habits that persists over a period of 2 weeks Ask a doctor or pharmacist before use if you are presently taking a stool softener laxative. Stop use and ask a doctor if ▪ you notice rectal bleeding or fail to have a bowel movement after use of a laxative. This may indicate a serious condition. Discontinue use and consult a doctor. ▪ you need to use the product more than one week
